# Siksha Sankalp Foundation

> Siksha Sankalp Foundation is a registered Indian non-profit organization (NGO) dedicated to transforming underprivileged children's lives through grassroots footpath schooling, formal school admissions, free digital libraries, nutritional aid, and community welfare in Noida and Delhi NCR, India. All public donations qualify for 80G tax exemption.

## Organization Overview
- **Official Name:** Siksha Sankalp Foundation
- **Type:** Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) / Registered Non-Profit Trust
- **Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh & Delhi NCR, India
- **Tax Benefits:** 80G Certified (50% tax deduction for Indian donors under Income Tax Act) & 12A registered
- **Official Website:** https://www.sikshasankalp.com
- **Official Email:** sikshasankalpfoundation@gmail.com
- **Official Phone:** +91-9958178873
- **Primary Focus:** Grassroots child education, slum education, footpath schools, digital literacy, school admissions, community empowerment.

## Core Initiatives & Programs
- **Footpath School Initiative:** Open-air learning centers providing foundational literacy, numeracy, and life skills to children living on streets and in slum clusters of Noida.
- **Mainstream School Admissions:** Enrolling underprivileged children into formal recognized schools, covering school fees, books, bags, and uniforms.
- **Free Digital Library & Computer Lab:** Bridging the digital divide by giving slum children access to computers, online educational content, and basic software skills.
- **Child Health & Nutrition Drives:** Regular nutritional snacks, hygiene kits, dental and health checkup camps for enrolled children.
- **Women & Community Upliftment:** Vocational workshops and basic literacy sessions for mothers in slum communities.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: Are donations to Siksha Sankalp Foundation tax deductible?**
  A: Yes, donations are eligible for 50% deduction under Section 80G of the Indian Income Tax Act. Donors receive an automated 80G receipt immediately after donating.
- **Q: Where does the NGO operate?**
  A: Siksha Sankalp Foundation primarily operates across Noida (Sector 62, Sector 128, and adjacent clusters) and Delhi NCR, India.
- **Q: Can individuals or college students volunteer?**
  A: Yes. College students, working professionals, and community members can volunteer for weekend teaching, mentoring, content creation, or organizing collection drives.
- **Q: How does the NGO fund its operations?**
  A: The foundation is funded through voluntary individual contributions, CSR partnerships, and community philanthropy.
